artifact_findings: All 12 SAS and SSS triangle problems were independently recomputed with the law of cosines; every side, angle, contextual distance, and rounding is correct.
The sequence cleanly alternates side and angle cases, includes contextual applications, and the key explains law selection, largest-side sanity checks, and rounding.
Diagrams are clear and consistent with the givens, and all artifacts are complete; the seven-page worksheet is visually sparse despite appropriate work space.
rationale: Every triangle value, diagram label, unit, and open explanation agrees with independent calculation. The procedural ramp and supporting materials are strong and complete; the only minor weakness is the expansive seven-page worksheet layout.
